guidance: Use IAM Access Analyzer to discover resources shared outside your account or organization and identify unused roles, access keys, and permissions. Cleaning up unintended access reduces blast radius in a compromise. External access analysis is free; unused access analysis is paid. CIEM solutions (e.g., Wiz, Tenable, Palo Alto Prisma) can also assist and are often bundled in CNAPP platforms.
how_to_check: Is an external access analyzer defined for your organization? Has IAM Access Analyzer been used to identify unused permissions and access keys? Is someone actively remediating findings? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
